verdict.rationale: Zulip publishes a complete OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec (zerver/openapi/zulip.yaml, ~1.5MB) in its official repo, confirmed via direct fetch, and the docs site (zulip.com/api) is built from this same machine-readable spec. While convenience endpoints like /openapi.json 404, the actual spec is readily downloadable and used to power the live API docs.
